about: JSW Steel Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India and internationally. The company offers hot and cold rolled steel products, colour coated sheets, galvanized and galvalume steel, electrical steel, steel doors, zinc-magnesium-aluminium products, aluminium-zinc roofing products, tin plate, TMT bars, wire rods, special alloy steel, grinding media, prepainted colour coated steel, low-carbon steel, hot-rolled sheets, structural steel, and low relaxation pre-stressed concrete
